title: Rod Cutting
description: `prices[i]` is the price of a rod piece of length `i + 1`. A rod of length `n` may be cut into any number of integer-length pieces. Return the maximum obtainable total price.
hints: Define a state by the capacity or sum achievable after processing a prefix.
For 0/1 choices, update capacities in descending order so an item is not reused.
